name: Rosé Pine
author: Shirowwww
description: All natural pine, faux fur and a bit of soho vibes: the Rosé Pine palettes (Main, Moon, Dawn) with iris and rose accents, round panels and pill-shaped playback display. Palette by the Rosé Pine community (MIT).
